Overview

ESG-Compliant Cooperative Ecosystem with Starlink

Our three-tier cooperative structure — from provincial governance to ward-level farming — is digitally unified through Starlink satellite connectivity, enabling every Manus community to access global markets, transparent governance, and real-time reporting.

Pis Na Saksak Manus Cooperative Society — ESG-Compliant Cooperative Ecosystem with Starlink  ·  OVAL & WW — 15/05/2026
Pis Na Saksak Manus Cooperative Society is an ESG-compliant cooperative ecosystem established exclusively for Manus Province, Papua New Guinea. Designed to empower tribal citizens and build sustainable, generational wealth, it operates as a three-tier cooperative structure — all digitally connected via Starlink satellite internet — ensuring every community has access to markets, governance platforms, and real-time reporting.
Full NamePis Na Saksak Cooperative Society

Established2026

Who we are

Vision & Mission

Vision
Manus Province will achieve provincial economic independence through a digitally connected, ESG-compliant cooperative ecosystem that empowers every tribal family and ward.
Mission
To integrate tribal cooperatives, provincial authorities, and ESG-aligned partners into a unified platform that drives sustainable production, transparent governance, and inclusive prosperity for all Manus families.

Identity Narrative

The Story Behind Our Emblem

Our visual identity elegantly balances traditional regional resources with modern technology — representing a progressive, community-driven cooperative ecosystem.

🍣
Pis
The Fish
Symbolises marine riches, sustainable coastal harvesting, and the enduring livelihood of Manus coastal populations.
🌿
Saksak
The Sago Palm
Honours land-based agricultural abundance, food resilience, and the deep cultural heritage of Manus Province.
🛰
Net Grid
Satellite & Connectivity
Illustrates digital connectivity, cutting-edge infrastructure, global market reach, and structural unity across all wards.

What we do

Key Objectives

Through the Tribe Citizens Economic Empowerment Program, we are committed to five transformative pillars for Manus Province.

01
Food Security
Enhancing local farming and fishing capabilities across all 131 wards of Manus Province.
02
Income Generation
Creating export pathways and wholesale distribution channels for Manus products.
03
Sustainable Development
Integrating Starlink, Blockchain, and MIS digital tools with traditional Manus livelihoods.
04
Digital Inclusion
Expanding digital literacy and connectivity to every ward via Starlink satellite kits.
05
Generational Wealth
Building lasting member equity through the Manus Unit Trust Fund (UTF) — securing prosperity for future generations of Manus families across all 131 wards.

How we operate

Three-Tier Cooperative Structure

Our cooperative model functions at every level — from the province to the village — ensuring no community is left behind.

I
Provincial
Tier 1 — Provincial Level
Pis Na Saksak Cooperative Society
Oversees governance, compliance, export operations, and the Manus Unit Trust Fund. Acts as Exporter and Trustee for the entire province.
BPNGDCIKCHWorld BankIFCADBUNDPGEF
II
LLG
Tier 2 — 12 Local Level Governments
LLG Processing Cooperatives
Downstream processing and packaging centres across all 12 Manus LLGs. Adds value to raw products before export to national and global markets.
NFACCDAGCFFAOUSAIDJICA
III
Ward
Tier 3 — 131 Wards
Ward Farming Cooperatives
Ward-level cooperatives engaged in farming, fishing, and digital training. The foundation of production — each connected via Starlink for digital access and real-time reporting.

Compliance Framework
ESG — People, Planet & Prosperity
E
Environment
Protects marine biodiversity, promotes blue-carbon credits, and adopts eco-friendly farming practices across all of Manus Province.
S
Social
Provides tribal citizens with ownership rights, digital inclusion, equitable participation, and food and income security for all Manus families.
G
Governance
Ensures transparent fund management via the Unit Trust Fund, regulator-ready reporting, blockchain audit trails, and digital monitoring across all tiers.
Technology Backbone
🛰 Digital Infrastructure
All 131 wards, LLG centres, and the Cooperative are connected via Starlink satellite — bringing markets, governance, and real-time reporting to every community. Three integrated Management Information Systems are linked through Blockchain for immutable records and transparent audit trails.
👤
Membership MIS
Member registration, identity, cooperative participation, and digital training portals.
🛒
Online Shop MIS
Wholesale and retail transactions, loyalty rebates, and cooperative e-commerce.
📈
Unit Trust Fund MIS
Subscriptions, redemptions, buy-backs, and dividend distribution for member equity.

Legal Foundation

Constitutional Basis

The Society is governed by the Pis Na Saksak Cooperative Society Constitution, which enshrines all operational, governance, and financial frameworks.

Art. 1
Name & Guiding Principles: ESG compliance, Starlink integration, and the Triple Bottom Line
Art. 2
Objectives: Food security, income generation, and sustainable development
Art. 3
Three-Tier Organisational Structure and responsibilities across all levels
Art. 4
Membership and Eligibility: Open to all tribal and village groups across Manus Province
Art. 5
Governance and Administration: Digital infrastructure and downstream management
Art. 6
Financial Provisions: Unit Trust Fund, value addition, and export revenue streams
